reasonText: The indoor case papers and the discharge summary of the hospital record that you are a known case of hypertension for the last 9 years and have been taking Telmisartan 40 mg daily. This condition was not disclosed in the proposal form dated 12/04/2019, where the question on hypertension and heart disease was answered "No". The Company considers this a non-disclosure of a material fact.
